statements.t: The accompanying consolidated financial statements have been prepared assuming that we will continue as a going concern.
We believe that we will continue to incur operating and net losses each quarter until at least the time we begin significant deliveries of our products.

estimates.name: Fair Value of Convertible Instruments and Embedded Derivatives
estimates.t: The determination of fair value involves significant judgment and the use of complex valuation models, including Monte Carlo simulations, and Binomial lattice models.
